cells.gaps: No share or count of municipalities connected is published and no total of municipalities is given: the 16 on Taamir are a count without its denominator, and the 71 per cent of sites on the administrative network in 2024 (TUN-022) covers ministries, collectivities and sectoral networks together. The Taamir sources do not say how the municipal offices are connected; the institutional connection rests on separate sources (TUN-019, TUN-021), neither of which says how many municipal offices are on it, so the government-network flag is not set. Donor finance (TUN-005) is the Taamir platform's, not the connection's; TUN-016 and TUN-017 are from the excluded compilation and set nothing.
cells.note: Municipalities outside the capital work in a national system past its test (Taamir, 16 named municipalities) and municipal workstations are connected to the state data centre, which meets stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half on a share or a count with a denominator from a source that also states the institutional connection, and none is held.
